Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to add the corresponding values of two arrays
of integers. 
Input Description:
The program should accept: 
Two arrays of integers, arr1[] and arr2[], both of size n
(where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000). The arrays will contain integer values. 
Output Description:
The program should print the resulting array where each element is
the sum of the corresponding elements from arr1[] and arr2[]. 
Sample Input:
 3
1 2 3
4 5 6 
Sample Output:
 5 7 9
